text:
Alice: noticed the metrics console is much slower after yesterday's deploy — heatmap & timeseries take noticeably longer to become interactive. seeing FCP/TTI spikes in telemetry. anyone else?
Mateo: yup, I got an alert around 20:12. flamegraphs point to main-thread work during chart init.
Priya: did a bundle change land? any new deps pulled into main chunk?
Jamal: build stats show ~850KB bump in the client vendor chunk. looks like a util import got pulled into main.
Li: I reverted a tiny deferred-import last night but thought it was disabled on canary. odd.
Nora: quick repro steps: open org -> metrics -> apply 90d range + smoothing. CPU climbs and the UI freezes for ~600-800ms while charts mount.
Alice: snippet from telemetry (sample):
```
main-thread: 820ms
chart-init: 560ms
bundle-load: 120ms
```
Mateo: we already use dynamic imports for charts generally. but the new viz util does `import 'viz/layout'` at module top-level which drags it into the main bundle.
Priya: that matches. The PR that added the util changed a couple of exports and accidentally made the util a side-effect import in index.ts.
Jamal: easy fix is to convert to inline dynamic import at render time: `const { renderHeatmap } = await import('./viz/layout')`. I can prepare a hotfix.
Li: also flagging the cache: our route-level HTTP cache TTL for /org/* was set to 0 in the rollout config yesterday (prob accidental). that means prefix cache misses are forcing full re-render + recompute.
Nora: ugh, the rollout toggle for console-cache-ttl was flipped during the rollout rollback flow. I'll check the flag history.
deploy-bot: deploy 1842106600 to prod started by @Nora — status: success
Mateo: plan: ship hotfix that lazy-loads viz utils + revert cache TTL to 1h. roll out canary 5% first with telemetry gating.
Priya: also add a small regression test in our e2e that loads the heatmap route and asserts FCP < 500ms on CI — catches regressions early.
Alice: I'll own telemetry gating and the alert thresholds (increase sensitivity so we catch bigger regressions).
Jamal: taking hotfix PR, will open in ~8m and request review. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/7890
Li: I'll audit rollout flags and restore TTL; if anything else changed in the cache key format we should catch it in the next run.
Nora: setting canary to 5% now and tagging infra-oncall.
Alice: sounds good. once hotfix is on canary we'll watch the traces for improvements and then ramp. thanks all :thumbsup:
